description: rhize-devflow auto-wires the auto-selection workflow gate: material implementation/refactor prompts require a CodeGraph-or-recorded-fallback impact-map receipt before source edits (native edit tools and recognizable shell writes), flag source a shell changed while no map was prepared, and require reconciliation before commit/completion. Trusted adapters may invoke the same gate with required activation and an explicit implementation task kind; the study control omits the plugin instead of disabling the gate. The mutation and protected-file guards remain opt-in through setup/manifest.json. Native update safety denies recognizable in-session Rhize package mutations and stops sessions after installed metadata changes. Missing Dev Flow scripts hold tools and stop without a retrying Stop-hook error.

Save the checkpoint, stop tools and restart all affected hosts. Never retry missing-hook errors or disable guards.","systemMessage":"Rhize plugin files unavailable: required guards have not run.
